name: AddReportComment
text: mutation AddReportComment($input: AddCommentInput!, $clientRequestId: String) { addReportComment(input: $input, clientRequestId: $clientRequestId) { id reportId content isInternal createdAt } }

name: AdjudicateReport
text:
mutation AdjudicateReport($input: AdjudicateReportInput!, $clientRequestId: String) { adjudicateReport(input: $input, clientRequestId: $clientRequestId) { ...CertificateFields } }
fragment CertificateFields on PayoutCertificateModel { id reference reportId adjudicationId organizationId researcherId researcherUsername reportTitle grossAmount withheldAmount netAmount currency status issuedAt appealClosesAt dueAt isOverdue researcherVerified paymentDueAt voidReason disputeClosesAt graderSide graderUsername criticalReviewOutcome settlement { id attestedById attestedByUsername method reference paidAt note withheldAmount withholdingReason disputedAt disputeReason createdAt proof { id fileName contentType fileSize fileAccess createdAt } } receipt { receivedAt amountReceived differenceReason onBehalf declaredAt confirmsAttestation } expectedAmount openAppealBy }

name: AdminUser
text:
query AdminUser($id: ID!) { adminUser(id: $id) { ...AdminUserFields } }
fragment AdminUserFields on AdminUserModel { id email username roles status kycStatus emailVerified approvedAt rejectedAt rejectionReason isAmbassador twoFactorEnabled lastLogin createdAt organizationCount }
